newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan to boost 97/98 capital investment - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nissan to boost 97/98 capital investment - paper.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd will boost its capital investment in the 1997/98 business year to 110 billion yen, up 38 percent from 1996/97 levels, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.

The Japanese automaker will use the funds to roll out more models in the year starting from April, aiming to boost its domestic sales to counter rivals Toyota Motor Corp and Honda Motor Co Ltd, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Nissan officials could not immediately confirm the report.
Nissan is planning to launch eight new models in 1997/98, three more than in 1996/97, the paper said.
